arguments.text:
Implemented all 3 milestones for click shell completion:
- m1: Fixed `add_completion_class` to return `cls` instead of `None`, changing return type annotation from `None` to `t.Type[ShellComplete]` and adding `return cls`
- m2: Added `.replace(".", "_")` to dot-to-underscore replacement in `_main_shell_completion` (core.py) so prog_name dots produce valid env var names like `_MY_APP_COMPLETE`
- m3: Modified `BashComplete` to detect bash version and include it in generated script as `__bash_version='...'` with single quotes, preventing syntax errors from parentheses in versions like `5.2.12(1)-release` on Git for Windows

All 575 relevant tests pass (1 pre-existing Python 3.12 compatibility failure in test_bytes_args is unrelated). Three commits created: 6abf26d, ac7e14e, dff4d88.
